title: Linear-quadratic mixed Stackelberg-zero-sum game for mean-field regime switching system
summary: Motivated by a green finance problem, a linear-quadratic Stackelberg differential game for a regime switching system involving one leader and two followers is studied. The two followers engage in a zero-sum differential game, and both the state system and the cost functional incorporate a conditional mean-field term. Applying continuation method and induction method, we first establish the existence and uniqueness of the conditional mean-field forward-backward stochastic differential equations with Markovian switching.
